name: Mutagenic Biomatter
desc: Bulk input for refining, fusing and body swaps at the geneshaping bench. Ungraded. Four spool into one Histone Spool.

name: Histone Spool
desc: Spent to coil a new chromosome connection at the geneshaping bench; the cost rises with the connection length. Spooled from biomatter, slime gel or bone dust. Ungraded.

name: Slime Gel
desc: Dropped by slimes. Six spool into one Histone Spool. Otherwise sold.

name: Warm Slime Gel
desc: Rune inlay. Weapon: +2 heat damage. Armor: +5% heat resistance. Accessory: +4% heat resistance. Dropped by warm slimes.

name: Chilled Slime Gel
desc: Rune inlay. Weapon: +2 cold damage. Armor: +5% cold resistance. Accessory: +4% cold resistance. Dropped by cold slimes.

name: Charged Slime Gel
desc: Rune inlay. Weapon: +6% of damage as lightning. Armor: +5% lightning resistance. Accessory: +2% speed. Dropped by charged slimes.

name: Luminous Slime Gel
desc: Rune inlay. Weapon: +3 light damage. Armor: +6% dark resistance. Accessory: +5% light resistance. Dropped by luminous slimes.

name: Void Slime Gel
desc: Dropped by void slimes. No crafting use yet. Sells for 18 gold.

name: Slime Core
desc: Dropped by slimes and slime bosses. No crafting use yet. Sells for 45 gold.

name: Common Herb
desc: Raw herb. Gathered from herb beds. Eight go into a Herbal Charm; also a raw cooking ingredient.

name: Iron Scrap
desc: Three smelt into one Iron Ingot at a forge.

name: Iron Ingot
desc: Smithing stock. Smelted from 3 Iron Scrap. The anvil spends it at 6 cells of metal per ingot.

name: Boss Token
desc: Dropped by bosses. No use yet. Sells for 100 gold.

name: Ridge Amber
desc: Dropped by some monsters of the Malgeri Mountains. No use yet. Sells for 70 gold.

name: Blank Runestone
desc: Base slab for the rune bench. Graded: the stone grade sets how strongly the carved pattern works.

name: Gold Leaf
desc: Rune inlay. Weapon: +3% damage. Armor: +8 max HP. Accessory: +5% gold gain.

name: Cut Garnet
desc: Rune gem. Weapon: +2% crit. Armor: +3 armor. Accessory: +10% crit damage. Up to two gems per rune.

name: Ochre Pigment
desc: Rune pigment. Weapon: +1.5 damage. Armor: +1.5 armor. Accessory: +2% loot.

name: Verdigris Pigment
desc: Rune pigment. Weapon: +2 poison damage. Armor: +5% poison resistance. Accessory: +4% poison resistance.

name: Bone Dust
desc: Rune inlay. Armor: +5 max HP. Accessory: +3% dark resistance. Three also spool into one Histone Spool.

name: Raw Sapphire
desc: Rune gem. Weapon: +3 spell power. Armor: +4 max mana. Accessory: +0.05 mana regen. Up to two gems per rune.

name: Bronze Chisel
desc: Carving tool. Not consumed. Lowers the chance the slab splits; scales with the tool grade. Does not change the rune.

name: Steel Burin
desc: Carving tool. Not consumed. Lowers the chance the slab splits; scales with the tool grade. Does not change the rune.

name: Wild Onion
desc: Raw vegetable. Gathered. Whole, so it can be cut on the Cutting Board before cooking.

name: River Fish
desc: Raw fish; counts as meat. Whole, so it can be cut on the Cutting Board before cooking.

name: Cave Mushroom
desc: Raw mushroom; counts as a vegetable. Whole, so it can be cut on the Cutting Board before cooking.

name: Rock Salt
desc: Raw seasoning. Sits outside the stove timeline, so simmer time does not change what it adds.

name: Rough Flour
desc: Raw grain. Two measures make a Rustic Loaf.

name: Forest Berries
desc: Raw fruit. Cooking ingredient for the hot benches and the counter.

name: Bird Egg
desc: Raw egg. Gathered from nests. Cooking ingredient.

name: Wild Honey
desc: Raw sweet seasoning. Sits outside the stove timeline, so simmer time does not change what it adds.

name: Hearty Stew
desc: Eat: Well Fed ×1 for 10 minutes (+8 max HP, +10% stamina regen, slow HP restore). Signature, after 100 cooks: also Stoked ×0.5.

name: Skewered Fish
desc: Eat: Steady Hand ×1 for 8 minutes (+3% crit, +2% parry). Cooked filling; can go onto the Cold Counter as an ingredient. Signature, after 100 cooks: also Well Fed ×0.5.

name: Seared Steak
desc: Eat: Well Fed ×1 and Steady Hand ×0.5. Cooked filling; can go onto the Cold Counter as an ingredient. Signature, after 100 cooks: also Stoked ×0.5.

name: Charred Roots
desc: Eat: Well Fed ×0.75. Cooked; can go onto the Cold Counter as an ingredient. Signature, after 100 cooks: also Steady Hand ×0.5.

name: Rustic Loaf
desc: Eat: Well Fed ×0.6. Cooked bread; the base ingredient for Cold Counter dishes. Signature, after 100 cooks: also Clear-Headed ×0.5.

name: Berry Pie
desc: Eat: Well Fed ×1 for 10 minutes (+8 max HP, +10% stamina regen, slow HP restore). Signature, after 100 cooks: also Clear-Headed ×0.5.

name: Honey Cake
desc: Eat: Clear-Headed ×1 (+8% spell power, +5% skill XP, slow mana restore) and Well Fed ×0.5. Signature, after 100 cooks: also Steady Hand ×0.5.

name: Hearty Sandwich
desc: Eat: Well Fed ×1 and Steady Hand ×0.75 (+3% crit, +2% parry at full strength). Signature, after 100 cooks: also Stoked ×0.5.

name: Forest Salad
desc: Eat: Clear-Headed ×0.5 and Well Fed ×0.5. Signature, after 100 cooks: also Steeped ×0.5.

name: Mushroom Broth
desc: Drink: Clear-Headed ×1 for 8 minutes (+8% spell power, +5% skill XP, slow mana restore). Signature, after 100 cooks: also Steeped ×0.5.

name: Herb-Rubbed Meat
desc: Eat: restores 15% of max HP at once, then Well Fed ×1. Learned dish: any meat + any herb on the Cooking Stove. Signature, after 100 cooks: also Clear-Headed ×0.5.

name: Fish and Onion Pot
desc: Eat: Well Fed ×1 and Steady Hand ×0.75. Learned dish: any fish + any vegetable on the Cooking Stove. Signature, after 100 cooks: also Clear-Headed ×0.5.

name: Lectory Porridge
desc: Eat: Clear Headed ×1.5 (spell power, skill XP, slow mana restore) and Well Fed ×0.5. Learned dish: any grain + any sweet ingredient on the Cooking Stove. Signature, after 100 cooks: also Steady Hand ×0.5.

name: Seared Stew
desc: Eat: Stoked ×1 for 5 minutes (+5% damage, +0.05 critical damage multiplier). Learned dish: any meat + any vegetable on the Cooking Stove, with the meat cooking for under 6 units. Signature, after 100 cooks: also Well Fed ×0.5.

name: Braised Meat
desc: Eat: Well Fed ×1.5 for 15 minutes (+12 max HP, +15% stamina regen, slow HP restore). Learned dish: any meat + any vegetable on the Cooking Stove, with the meat cooking for 14 units or more. Signature, after 100 cooks: also Steady Hand ×0.5.

name: Steeped Broth
desc: Drink: Steeped ×1 for 10 minutes (+25% poison resistance, +10% acid resistance). Learned dish: any mushroom + any herb on the Cooking Stove, with the herb cooking for 8 units or more. Signature, after 100 cooks: also Clear-Headed ×0.5.

name: Recipe: Herb-Rubbed Meat
desc: Read to learn Herb-Rubbed Meat: any meat + any herb on the Cooking Stove. Consumed when read. Sold at the Larder Door.

name: Recipe: Fish and Onion Pot
desc: Read to learn Fish and Onion Pot: any fish + any vegetable on the Cooking Stove. Consumed when read. Sold at the Larder Door.

name: Recipe: Lectory Porridge
desc: Read to learn Lectory Porridge: any grain + any sweet ingredient (flour and honey) on the Cooking Stove. Consumed when read. Found only while reading in the Reading Hall.

name: Recipe: Seared Stew (meat under 6)
desc: Read to learn Seared Stew: any meat + any vegetable on the Cooking Stove. The meat must cook under 6 units: put it in midway on a Quick simmer. Outside that window the same ingredients make Hearty Stew. Consumed when read. Sold at the Larder Door.

name: Recipe: Braised Meat (meat 14 or more)
desc: Read to learn Braised Meat: any meat + any vegetable on the Cooking Stove. The meat must cook 14 units or more: put it in first on a Long braise. Outside that window the same ingredients make Hearty Stew. Consumed when read. Sold at the Larder Door.

name: Recipe: Steeped Broth (herb 8 or more)
desc: Read to learn Steeped Broth: any mushroom + any herb on the Cooking Stove. The herb must cook 8 units or more: put it in first, on any simmer. Outside that window the same ingredients make Mushroom Broth. Consumed when read. Sold at the Larder Door.

name: Word Slip: Stone
desc: Read to learn the arcane word stone, outside the starting lexicon. Castable once Arcana reaches its level. Consumed when read.

name: Votive Token
desc: Offer for favor. The first token offered gives +2 favor with every god you know and +2 starting favor with any god you meet later. Each later token gives 1 unassigned favor, placed on a god of your choice on the Divine tab.

name: Drill Manual: Riposte
desc: Study to learn Riposte in canonical form, or to perfect a rough one. Consumed when studied.

name: Chancery Price Seal
desc: Register for a standing 10% discount at every counter in Threshold, never below what an item resells for. Consumed when registered.

name: Unclaimed Case File
desc: An Assize case file nobody collected. Read it. Consumed when read.

name: Smith's Pattern: Bronze
desc: Study to add the copper, tin and bronze ingot recipes to the Forges. A piece forged at the anvil with a bronze head carries +15% Acuity and +10% Coherence. Consumed when studied.

name: Traveler's Ration
desc: Eat: Well Fed ×0.5. Signature, after 100 cooks: also Steady Hand ×0.5.

name: Feast Platter
desc: Eat: restores 25% of max HP at once, plus Well Fed ×2 and Steady Hand ×1.5. Signature, after 100 cooks: also Stoked ×0.5.

name: Scorched Mess
desc: A failed cook. Eat: Queasy for 90 seconds (poison damage over time, -25% stamina regen). Clears on rest.

name: Healing Salve
desc: Apply: restores 25 HP plus 10% of max HP at once. Counts as treatment, so it closes wounds only treatment closes. Has a cooldown.

name: Spring Water
desc: Alembic base: water. Elixir when calm, Draught when roused. Holds up to 8 potency.

name: Pressed Oil
desc: Alembic base: oil. Salve when calm, weapon Oil when roused. Holds up to 6 potency.

name: Grain Spirit
desc: Alembic base: spirit. Fume when calm, Flask when roused. Holds up to 5 potency and adds 0.5 volatility. Alchemy 4.

name: Emberbloom
desc: Alembic essence: Ember (heat). Inflicts On Fire in a Flask or Oil. No effect in drinkable forms.

name: Frostmoss
desc: Alembic essence: Rime (cold). Inflicts Chilled in a Flask, Fume or Oil; grants Xima's Rime in an Elixir.

name: Nightcap
desc: Alembic essence: Venom (poison). Inflicts Poisoned in a Flask, Fume or Oil. Alchemy 3.

name: Gloomcap
desc: Alembic essence: Gloom (dark). Inflicts Dazzled in a Flask, Fume or Oil; grants Veiled in an Elixir. Alchemy 6.

name: Mendroot
desc: Alembic essence: Mending. Restores HP in a Draught or Salve; grants Well Fed in an Elixir; a Salve of it cures poison and bleed.

name: Bloodwort
desc: Alembic essence: Vigor. Restores stamina in a Draught or Salve; grants Blood Communion in an Elixir. Alchemy 5.

name: Thunderbloom
desc: Alembic essence: Storm (lightning). Inflicts Jolted in a Flask, Fume or Oil; restores mana in a Draught or Salve; grants Clear-Headed in an Elixir. Alchemy 9.

name: Quicksilver
desc: Alembic operator: volatility +1.3. Roused is 1.0 or more. Alchemy 2.

name: Fixing Salt
desc: Alembic operator: sets volatility to 0.15; each point removed adds 50% duration (45 seconds base, cap 150). No effect on a calm brew.

name: Brimstone
desc: Alembic operator: if volatility is at least 1.2, potency ×1.55. If not, final potency ×0.82. Alchemy 7.

name: Bone Ash
desc: Alembic operator: removes the weakest essence added before it; the other essences' effects ×1.5 and potency ×1.25. Alchemy 4.

name: Green Vitriol
desc: Alembic operator: armour pierce +22%, potency ×1.25, final potency ×0.88. Alchemy 11.

name: Iron Pot
desc: Cookware for the Cooking Stove tool slot. Not consumed. Sits outside the stove timeline.

name: Copper Ore
desc: Three smelt into one Copper Ingot at a forge.

name: Copper Ingot
desc: Smithing stock. Smelted from 3 Copper Ore. Four plus one Tin Ingot make a Bronze Ingot.

name: Tin Ingot
desc: Smithing stock. Smelted from 3 Tin Ore. One plus four Copper Ingots make a Bronze Ingot.

name: Tin Ore
desc: Three smelt into one Tin Ingot at a forge.

name: Bronze Ingot
desc: Smithing stock. Made from 4 Copper Ingots and 1 Tin Ingot. A piece forged at the anvil with a bronze head carries +15% Acuity and +10% Coherence.

name: Leather
desc: Leatherworking stock, tanned from fur (4 ruined furs per piece; better fur yields more). The anvil spends it as straps and cords: 3 cells per leather.

name: Ship’s Cannon
desc: Fitted in the hold while carried: on the harbor band’s waters each one adds a volley to your battery on every leg a cannonball loads them. Up to 4 count. Never spent. Made at the quay on floor 11 from 6 iron ingots.

name: Cannonball
desc: Battery shot. One is spent each convoy leg you are present for, if a cannon is carried, and loads every cannon. Made at the quay on floor 11, 3 from 1 iron ingot.

name: Powder Charge
desc: Battery powder. One is spent each convoy leg you are present for: +1 hit, which multiplies the volleys. Made at the quay on floor 11, 2 from 3 biomatter and 1 iron scrap.

name: Pilot’s Passage
desc: The receipt for a pilot on floor 13. Buying it opens the Pilot’s Channel into the blockade, where the blockaders are caught Surprised. Sold by the pilot at the Last Port.

name: Port Clearance
desc: Papers for the closed port on floor 14, bought from the harbor master on floor 13. The merchants’ factor takes it for Clear the Closed Port. Merchants only.

name: Sliced Raw Meat
desc: Raw Meat, sliced. Its grade is the cut grade, not the ingredient's grade. The grade sets what share of the ingredient's contribution reaches the dish (Divine: all of it).

name: Diced Raw Meat
desc: Raw Meat, diced. Its grade is the cut grade, not the ingredient's grade. The grade sets what share of the ingredient's contribution reaches the dish (Divine: all of it).

name: Julienned Raw Meat
desc: Raw Meat, julienned. Its grade is the cut grade, not the ingredient's grade. The grade sets what share of the ingredient's contribution reaches the dish (Divine: all of it).

name: Sliced Wild Onion
desc: Wild Onion, sliced. Its grade is the cut grade, not the ingredient's grade. The grade sets what share of the ingredient's contribution reaches the dish (Divine: all of it).

name: Diced Wild Onion
desc: Wild Onion, diced. Its grade is the cut grade, not the ingredient's grade. The grade sets what share of the ingredient's contribution reaches the dish (Divine: all of it).

name: Julienned Wild Onion
desc: Wild Onion, julienned. Its grade is the cut grade, not the ingredient's grade. The grade sets what share of the ingredient's contribution reaches the dish (Divine: all of it).

name: Sliced River Fish
desc: River Fish, sliced. Its grade is the cut grade, not the ingredient's grade. The grade sets what share of the ingredient's contribution reaches the dish (Divine: all of it).

name: Diced River Fish
desc: River Fish, diced. Its grade is the cut grade, not the ingredient's grade. The grade sets what share of the ingredient's contribution reaches the dish (Divine: all of it).

name: Julienned River Fish
desc: River Fish, julienned. Its grade is the cut grade, not the ingredient's grade. The grade sets what share of the ingredient's contribution reaches the dish (Divine: all of it).

name: Sliced Cave Mushroom
desc: Cave Mushroom, sliced. Its grade is the cut grade, not the ingredient's grade. The grade sets what share of the ingredient's contribution reaches the dish (Divine: all of it).

desc: Cave Mushroom, julienned. Its grade is the cut grade, not the ingredient's grade. The grade sets what share of the ingredient's contribution reaches the dish (Divine: all of it).

name: Cold Vulnerability

name: Vulnerability Nuclease
desc: Changes the element of a weak point on the gene: a negative resistance, or an element that stops a conferred effect (heat and acid stop the Troll Gene’s regeneration), becomes the element of the mutation fused into the nuclease.
